models.positioning: DeepSeek efficiency-focused multimodal reasoning model for high-throughput agentic, coding, and general API workloads.
notes: DeepSeek publishes time-variable peak and off-peak USD token rates rather than one fixed Standard rate.
Peak hours are 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, Monday through Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays; all other times are off-peak.
The model is excluded from the SXF fixed-rate calculator until time-variable pricing is represented explicitly in calculator UX.
Knowledge cutoff remains unknown because the cited official documentation does not publish a verified cutoff.

variable.schedule: Peak hours are 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC Monday–Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays; otherwise off-peak.

models.positioning: Amazon's cost-efficient multimodal Nova 2 model for automation, document processing, video understanding, coding and agentic workflows.
notes: Amazon Bedrock documents Standard pay-per-token access, but pricing can vary by routing and region.
SXF stores the currently published AWS Standard reference rate of $0.30 input / $2.50 output per million tokens.
Reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens when extended thinking is enabled.
The base model card lists 64K max output; high extended-thinking workloads may exceed 65K in some cases, so the catalog preserves the documented base max-output contract.

verification_policy.rule: Core factual fields must cite official provider sources. Paid token pricing is normalized only when the provider publishes a directly comparable Standard API rate; unsupported pricing remains explicitly unavailable.
verification_policy.unknown_policy: Use null, omit unsupported claims, or use an explicit provider-documented sentinel such as max_output='unlimited'; never infer a value. Missing official paid pricing must remain outside Standard calculator rates.

calculator_policy.rule: Only provider-published Standard paid token rates are calculator-eligible. Preview-only, partner-priced, self-hosted, or unpublished pricing remains visible in the catalog but is excluded from cost calculations.
